name: Jesuit Missions of La Santísima Trinidad de Paraná and Jesús de Tavarangue
description: Set among the red-earth hills of Itapúa in southern Paraguay, these two ruined missions were built by Jesuits working with the Guaraní people in the 17th and 18th centuries. At Trinidad you can still walk through the great stone church, its carved pulpit and sculpted details still standing. Nearby Jesús, left unfinished, shows how these planned communities took shape.
